description: Builds a bounded, cycle-safe trace tree from one Work Item and returns `{nodes, edges, truncated}`. Requires a project ID and Work Item ID readable by the signed-in Polarion user. Use this to traverse multiple link levels; use `getLinkedWorkItems` or `getBacklinkedWorkItems` for a single hop. `direction` selects outgoing, incoming, or both; the result is marked truncated when the depth or node cap limits traversal.

depth.description: Maximum number of link hops from the root; defaults to 3 and is capped at 6.

direction.description: `down` follows outgoing links, `up` follows backlinks, and `both` traverses both directions; defaults to `both`.

node_cap.description: Maximum number of distinct Work Items to include; defaults to 200 and is capped at 1000.

projectId.description: Project ID that owns the root Work Item, such as `PROJECT`.

roles.description: Optional allowlist of link role IDs; omitted means include every role.

items.description: Exact Polarion link role ID to retain.

workItemId.description: Root Work Item ID within the project, such as `WI-123`, without the project prefix.

name: trace_links
title: Trace work item links
